## How engagements work
Free first consultation (in person, phone or WhatsApp) → document checklist → execution and filing with the authority or bank → certificates, approvals and acknowledgements delivered, with reminders for future due dates. Fees are quoted in writing in advance; government fees are charged at actuals. Tax and compliance work is delivered online across India; plan approval and site work serve Madurai and nearby districts.
